description: A user's own tasks, both standalone and belonging to a user_project. NOT the scheduler app's `tasks` table (508) - that one belongs to the Claude automation system, lives in a different Baserow database, and carries agent/phase columns that mean nothing here. Import TWENTY-EIGHTH (after user_projects)
notes: Named user_tasks so it can never be confused with the scheduler's `tasks` in the other database.
Users live in Xano, so user_id is TEXT holding String(user.id) - never a link field. EVERY read filters on it.

project_id is TEXT holding the user_projects ROW id, or the literal 'standalone'. Deliberately not a link_row: link fields cannot express 'standalone', and filtering a link field needs link_row_has with a row id, which the client does not always have.
completed is a real BOOLEAN. The scheduler table expresses completion through a status select (pending/approved/in_progress/...), which forced a lossy mapping in both directions.
depends_on was ADDED 2026-08-16 and is PENDING.
milestone_id was ADDED 2026-08-16 and is also PENDING - same treatment as status below.

status and progress_pct were ADDED 2026-08-15 and do not exist in the live table yet - run `node scripts/add-baserow-field.mjs` (needs a user JWT). Until then the app writes them and Baserow drops them silently, and toTask() derives status from `completed`. completed stays the source of truth for done/not-done so nothing that reads it breaks.
priority uses 'urgent', the word the app uses, rather than the scheduler's 'critical'.
estimated_hours and actual_hours allow 2 DECIMAL PLACES. With 0 places Baserow REJECTS the whole row - not just the field - so logging 2.5 hours failed the entire write.
tags is free TEXT (comma separated). A multiple_select would reject any tag not planned in advance.

user_id.description: Xano user id as a string. EVERY read filters on this

status.description: Where the task is. `completed` stays the truth for done/not-done; this adds the middle. PENDING in the live table

progress_pct.description: 0-100, hand-set. Only consulted when the task has no checklist. PENDING in the live table

estimated_hours.description: 2 dp: Baserow rejects the whole row on excess decimals

tags.description: Comma separated. Free text on purpose

depends_on.description: Comma separated user_tasks row ids that must be finished first. Stored on the WAITING task so one write changes a dependency; the reverse view is derived. PENDING in the live table

budget.description: What this one task is meant to cost. Its spending is the project_items and project_expenses tagged with it, which also belong to its project - one row, counted once, shown in both places

milestone_id.description: user_milestones row id. A task belongs to at most one milestone - membership lives here rather than as a list on the milestone, so one write moves it. PENDING in the live table
